blocks.html: What is JUPEB?

JUPEB (Joint Universities Preliminary Examinations Board) is a one-year, A-Level standard programme recognised by Nigerian universities. Successful candidates can use their JUPEB results to apply for Direct Entry admission into 200 Level. BIA JUPEB prepares students with focused classes, weekly tests, mock examinations and admission guidance.

description: Compare JUPEB and IJMB for 2026: duration, acceptance, subject combinations, and who should choose each.
title: JUPEB vs IJMB: Which Is Easier in 2026?
lead: A clear comparison to help you choose the right A-Level program.

blocks.html: Duration
JUPEB typically runs for about 8 to 9 months, while IJMB can take 9 to 12 months depending on the study center. If you want a faster route to Direct Entry in 2026, JUPEB is often preferred.
University Acceptance
Both programs are accepted by many Nigerian universities. BIA JUPEB's admission guidance currently focuses on the University of Lagos (UNILAG).
Subject Combination and Exam Style

JUPEB uses a modular exam style with a clear points system (A=5, B=4, C=3, D=2, E=1). IJMB uses a similar grading system but may differ in academic calendar and exam format. Your success depends on quality preparation and consistency.
Which Is Easier?

"Easier" depends on your study habits and support system. JUPEB is a shorter program, which many students prefer because it reduces time and cost. IJMB is longer but may give extra time for deeper revision. If you want a focused and structured approach, JUPEB with BIA JUPEB is an excellent choice.
For full details on JUPEB 2026, visit the JUPEB Guide or enquire about registration.

title: Can I Use Awaiting Result for JUPEB 2026?
lead: Yes, you can register with awaiting result, but there are important steps to follow.

blocks.html: Short Answer: Yes

BIA JUPEB accepts candidates with awaiting O'Level results. Your O'Level requirements must be complete before final JUPEB registration closes; the admissions office will guide you through the timeline.
What Documents You Need

items: O'Level result — an awaiting result is acceptable

blocks.html: When to Submit Your Result
Once your results are out, bring them to the BIA admissions office straight away to avoid delays in final registration. This is essential for Direct Entry admission into 200 Level.
Tips to Avoid Problems
Register early, attend classes consistently, and keep communication open with the BIA JUPEB team. Early registration gives you more time to prepare.
For more details, see the JUPEB Guide 2026 or contact admissions.
